acceptance: Decision gate: the item stays blocked until openai/codex#27833 is closed as fixed or a Codex release note says apply_patch runs PreToolUse hooks. Check both, and npm view @openai/codex version, before starting.
In a scratch repository with a catch-all PreToolUse hook that exits 2, the fixed Codex version refuses an apply_patch; the version and the observed result are recorded here.
A live probe from the primary clone, asking Codex to create guard-probe-codex.txt through apply_patch, is refused by the hook in .codex/hooks.json; the version and the result are recorded here.

The Codex row in docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md states the enforced version. If the hook now fires but does not refuse, a fix to the guard or to .codex/hooks.json merges with a test that feeds the real apply_patch payload.
Guardrails: probes create only guard-probe-<agent>.txt in the primary clone and delete it at once; nothing is ever committed in the primary clone; the hook wiring for other agents is not changed.
context: Blocked 2026-11-17: openai/codex#27833 is open and 0.169.0 is the latest @openai/codex release, a version already shown not to call the hook.
description: On 2026-11-15, codex-cli 0.162.1 and 0.169.0 never called a PreToolUse hook for apply_patch. The test used a scratch repository with a catch-all hook that exits 2, and from the primary clone Codex created a probe file through apply_patch (the file was deleted). The upstream issue is openai/codex#27833. On 2026-11-17 it was still open and 0.169.0 was the latest @openai/codex release. scripts/primary_clone_write_guard.py refuses the apply_patch payload when given it directly, so the gap is in Codex, not in the guard. Until Codex calls the hook, a Codex write to the primary clone is caught only afterwards: make agent-write-preflight reports changed tracked files and, since PR #4265, new untracked files that are not gitignored. docs/agent/primary-clone-guard.md (PR #4252) records this. This item is the separate upstream-limitation item that write-guard-unproven-outside-omp-20261112 requires.
